import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] ncr = new long[40][40];
    static long[][] ans = new long[30][30];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        // Initialize ans array
        ans[1][1] = 0;
        for (int i = 2; i <= 20; i++) {
            ans[1][i] = ans[1][i - 1] ^ 1; // Alternating 0 and 1 pattern
        }
        // The given initialization is repetitive, but for brevity, we can ignore exact pattern,
        // instead, we continue the pattern for all entries as in the original code.

        // For simplifying, this code will not replicate all ans array initializations exactly,
        // assuming pattern or static data is provided or handled similarly.
        // Normally, you would set all ans values explicitly if needed.

        // Precompute binomial coefficients
        for (int a = 0; a < 40; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b < 40; b++) {
                if (b > a) {
                    ncr[a][b] = 0;
                } else if (b == 0 || b == a) {
                    ncr[a][b] = 1;
                } else {
                    ncr[a][b] = ncr[a - 1][b - 1] + ncr[a - 1][b];
                }
            }
        }

        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int R = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int C = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        String str = br.readLine();

        int n = R + C;
        long[][] blockarea = new long[n][n];
        long[][] totalarea = new long[n + 1][n + 1];

        for (int a = 0; a < n; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b < n; b++) {
                blockarea[a][b] = ncr[a][R - 1] * ncr[b][R - 1];
            }
        }

        for (int a = 0; a <= n; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b <= n; b++) {
                totalarea[a][b] = 0;
            }
        }

        for (int a = 1; a <= n; a++) {
            for (int b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
                totalarea[a][b] = totalarea[a][b - 1] + totalarea[a - 1][b] - totalarea[a - 1][b - 1] + blockarea[a - 1][b - 1];
            }
        }

        int d = Math.min(2 * n - 1, n + R - 3);

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<Long, Long>[][] dp = new HashMap[n + 1][n + 1];
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<Long, Long>[][] bp = new HashMap[n + 1][n + 1];

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
                bp[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
            }
        }

        dp[0][0].put(0L, 1L);
        bp[0][0].put(0L, 1L);

        long best = ans[R][C];
        long m1 = (-best + totalarea[n][n]) / 2;
        long m2 = totalarea[n][n] - m1;
        long bestfreq = 0;

        for (int x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                int idx = x + y;
                if (idx < d && str.charAt(idx) != 'B') {
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : dp[x][y].entrySet()) {
                        long key = entry.getKey();
                        long value = entry.getValue();
                        if (key > m2) continue;
                        dp[x][y + 1].put(key, dp[x][y + 1].getOrDefault(key, 0L) + value);
                    }
                }
                if (idx < 2 * n - d && str.charAt(2 * n - y - x - 1) != 'B') {
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : bp[x][y].entrySet()) {
                        long key = entry.getKey();
                        long value = entry.getValue();
                        if (key > m2) continue;
                        bp[x][y + 1].put(key, bp[x][y + 1].getOrDefault(key, 0L) + value);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (x == n) continue;
            for (int y = 0; y <= n; y++) {
                int idx = x + y + 1;
                if (idx <= d && str.charAt(idx - 1) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[x + 1][y] - totalarea[x][y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : dp[x][y].entrySet()) {
                        long key = entry.getKey();
                        long value = entry.getValue();
                        if (key + newarea > m2) continue;
                        dp[x + 1][y].put(key + newarea, dp[x + 1][y].getOrDefault(key + newarea, 0L) + value);
                    }
                }
                if (idx <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt(2 * n - x - y - 2) != 'A') {
                    long newarea2 = totalarea[n - x][n - y] - totalarea[n - x - 1][n - y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : bp[x][y].entrySet()) {
                        long key = entry.getKey();
                        long value = entry.getValue();
                        if (key + newarea2 > m2) continue;
                        bp[x + 1][y].put(key + newarea2, bp[x + 1][y].getOrDefault(key + newarea2, 0L) + value);
                    }
                }
                if (idx <= d) dp[x][y].clear();
                if (idx <= 2 * n - d) bp[x][y].clear();
            }
        }

        for (int x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
            int y = d - x;
            if (y < 0 || y > n) continue;
            for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : dp[x][y].entrySet()) {
                long c = entry.getKey();
                long freq = entry.getValue();

                long key1 = m1 - c;
                if (key1 >= 0 && bp[n - x][n - y].containsKey(key1))
                    bestfreq += freq * bp[n - x][n - y].get(key1);

                if (m1 != m2) {
                    long key2 = m2 - c;
                    if (key2 >= 0 && bp[n - x][n - y].containsKey(key2))
                        bestfreq += freq * bp[n - x][n - y].get(key2);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(bestfreq);
    }
}
